sent: This is a normal heartbeat. [pause 0.3] The S-A node fires, the signal travels down through the A-V node, and both ventricles squeeze together. [pause 0.45] Now watch what happens in pulseless Vee-tack. [pause 0.35] One spot in the ventricle takes over and fires a fast loop of its own, bypassing the normal pathway. [pause 0.4] The ventricles race too fast to fill, and too little blood gets out. [pause 0.35] No pulse. [pause 0.45] Pulseless Vee-tack is shockable. [pause 0.35] Start CPR, and defibrillate as soon as possible. [pause 0.5] Practice it on A-C-L-S med Sim. [pause 0.35] A-C-L-S med dot com. [pause 1.2]
